# DORY — Autonomous Iterative AI Coding Agent Skill

> DORY implements the Ralph Wiggum Cold-Start Pressure Cooker loop. Eliminates token bleed and drives cold-start development cycles through a deterministic Tri-Gate.

## Overview
DORY is an open-source autonomous coding skill designed for modern AI developer agents including Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Cline, Windsurf, Aider, OpenAI Codex, Roo Code, and GitHub Copilot.
Instead of dragging an ever-expanding, hallucination-prone chat conversation that bleeds tokens, DORY treats the local filesystem and git diffs as durable ground truth.

## The D-O-R-Y Engineering Loop
- **D — Do the contract**: Write explicit contract & failing test first before touching application code.
- **O — Observe real results**: Execute native compiler, strict typechecker (PHPStan Level 8+, TypeScript strict), and test suite. Objective binary result: Exit Code 0 or fail.
- **R — Recognize mistakes**: Capture compiler diagnostics directly from disk; isolate fix without conversational fluff or memory drift.
- **Y — Yield verified code**: Commit to git only when all gates pass with Exit Code 0.

## Installation
Install DORY into any supported workspace:
```bash
npx skills add https://github.com/CodeWithTeds/dory --skill dory
```
